protocol.selection: Original FP64 FPS from index0; independently recomputed and charged for each case
protocol.factor: FP32 packed lower; one original FP64 Gaussian column; FP64 subtraction/sqrt/division, then FP32 storage
protocol.solve: FP64 forward/back substitution with promoted FP32 coefficients
protocol.refinement: x+=Ltilde^-T Ltilde^-1(rhs-Cx); regenerate exact original C products;20correction cap,1e-12 relative residual
protocol.scope: Primitive only. Setup named-array cap and separate setup trace; no full Schur/Krylov solver memory/performance claim.
protocol.dense_reference: Only after native construction and both refinement solves per case; never called by those algorithms.
